query: select 'lesson' as kind, s.name as serie, c.title as chapter_title, c.display_order::text as chapter_order, l.id::text as item_id, l.title as item_title, l.display_order::text as item_order, coalesce(length(l.content),0)::text as detail from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Histoire-Géographie' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2','C','D') and (l.title ilike '%fondements du développement économique de la Corée du Sud%' or l.title ilike '%CEDEAO%' or l.title ilike '%relations UE/ACP%') union all select 'citation' as kind, sub.name as serie, coalesce(cit.source_title,'') as chapter_title, coalesce(cit.created_at::date::text,'') as chapter_order, cit.id::text as item_id, cit.author || ' — ' || coalesce(cit.source_reference,'') as item_title, null::text as item_order, coalesce(cit.is_active,false)::text as detail from public.citations cit join public.subjects sub on sub.id=cit.subject_id order by kind, serie, chapter_order, item_order limit 300;
